themeDescription: Lost items, inventory search & store navigation

challenges.title: Navigating a 4-Story Mega Department Store
challenges.shortDescription: Enthusiastically guide a bewildered customer directly to the specialty ethnic section on the 3rd floor mezzanine.
challenges.mission: Provide clear, memorable directions or personally escort the customer to the escalator, pointing out key landmarks.

scenarioContext.startingSituation: I've been walking in circles for fifteen minutes! Where is your plus-size women's ethnic kurta section? Your directories only say 'Apparel', but this floor only has men's suits!

guestProfile.whatTheGuestCaresAboutMost: reaching the right rack without climbing more stairs needlessly

level1.name: HANDLE
level1.guestBehaviour: Asks for directions and expresses fatigue.
hiddenObjectives: Provide clear landmark directions (take central lift to 3rd floor, right past cosmetics)
Offer to walk them to the elevator

challenges.title: App Displays In-Stock But Shelf Is Empty
challenges.shortDescription: Check backend inventory, backroom storage boxes, and mannequin displays for a sought-after designer blazer.
challenges.mission: Check inventory handheld scanner, verify backroom unboxed deliveries, or check styling displays.

scenarioContext.startingSituation: Your brand app says there are two units of this Navy Slim Blazer size 42 right here at this store. I searched this entire rack three times and there is not a single one. Can someone actually check your stockroom?

guestProfile.whatTheGuestCaresAboutMost: finding the blazer or getting an honest answer

level1.name: HANDLE
level1.guestBehaviour: Shows the app product SKU and demands someone check the back.
hiddenObjectives: Scan barcode on store handheld system
Check visual merchandising mannequin and fitting room returns
Retrieve from stockroom or arrange reserve from nearby branch
possibleSolutions: Hold for delivery from nearby flagship

challenges.title: Left Behind Prescription Glasses in Trial Room
challenges.shortDescription: Securely retrieve and verify lost personal belongings left in a fitting room during afternoon peak hours.
challenges.mission: Check the lost-and-found security protocol, verify trial room cubicles, and safely restore the belonging to the rightful owner.

scenarioContext.startingSituation: Oh goodness, I tried on five dresses in Room 3 about twenty minutes ago, and I think I took off my gold-framed prescription glasses and left them on the side bench! Without them I cannot drive home!

level1.name: HANDLE
level1.guestBehaviour: Describes the glasses and seeks immediate inspection of the room.
hiddenObjectives: Inspect trial room 3 and attendant lost-property locker
Verify description and hand back safely

challenges.title: Elderly Shopper Searching for Diabetic Food Section
challenges.shortDescription: Patiently accompany a senior citizen through reorganized grocery aisles to locate organic low-glycemic staples.
challenges.mission: Offer physical assistance, walk alongside the shopper, read ingredient labels if requested, and provide thoughtful care.

scenarioContext.startingSituation: Beta, you people rearranged the whole store last week! I used to find the sugar-free biscuits and diabetic oats right by the front door, but now there are just potato chips here. Where have you hidden them?

level1.name: HANDLE
level1.guestBehaviour: Walks slowly with a trolley and asks for guidance.
hiddenObjectives: Personally walk alongside to Aisle 4B health food section
Offer to place heavier items in their trolley
